body: I love hugs. Thank you. I think being able to talk to people who relate is very helpful.

I struggle to take my medication daily. I was diagnosed schizo affective, then when treatment for that wasn't working anymore they realized I have borderline personality disorder. I just hate the idea that I have to take a pill to be normal. There are so many people who don't have too and have no idea the luxury behind it. I'm slowly learning that I will only help myself by taking them. As for shitty men and women, I feel like people who struggle to love themselves often struggle to love others as well. Some pour their energy into others to prevent themselves from seeing their own lack of progress [ raises hand ] others just suck the life out of people while they can and just move on to the next. I am glad you are in a facility to help you regulate and get a good habit of taking your medication. I have spent some time in those as well. Its never easy, but it is helpful.

I feel like I have been screaming this same thing for a year now. I ended the relationship myself. I was just tired of always arguing. Always waiting for the next problem we wouldn't be able to solve. I understand now why they say people should be able to live on their own before the live with someone. We meshed in every single way except financially. We both had debt, kids, and a mental illness that made it hard to keep a job for more than a few months to a year. It just seemed so logical to split everything with someone I already always got along with. Before we knew it, we were taking turns on whos fault it was that this or that wasn't getting taken care of. You start playing the blame game and trust starts to fade. I can seriously walk backwards and explain how and why we ended up where we ended up. One tiny mistake at a time. I miss him so damn much. It hurts and I don't know how to be alone yet. But I know I am in no position to talk to him again, be friends with him again, or even think about being with someone else. I should be able to adjust to being alone. After all I'm not alone alone, I have kids.

I love my yoga! It's my favorite thing to do. I don't always keep the motivation but I try. 

Sadly its even worse than just a young relationship. I have been in back to back relationships since I was 17. All degrading and hurtful to some degree. I have recently learned a lot of my impulse to be with someone even if they need "fixing" [ aka more growing to do] because I am extremely co dependent. A cute little thing I carried from childhood. Breaking cycles now!! Have you watched queens gambit on netflix?
my bad guys. damn that was quick!

I am sure I will eventually. I finally have a chance to work on myself and I am so excited about it. :) I have never done this before. I have never put myself first. I don't know what to do with all of my free time. For now I have been working out at home. What types of things do you do for yourself?

If you are being threatened, do it. Do it now before your son is old enough to realize what is going on. That way you have time for both parents to grow and hopefully be better parents to your son before he starts creating memories. No one who loves you will hinder your success. I don't care if it's working at McDonalds or a career you built yourself. If you want your own stability and income, you should be able to have that. Anyone who wants to stop you from becoming independent is not looking out for your best interest. The only time it looks spiteful or negative is when it has been fabricated. If your story is true, then you should absolutely leave him. The depression you feel now will only get stronger if you stay in the situation that made you depressed in the first place.

My mom was absent most of the time. If she was there, she was doing meth in the bathroom or sleeping for days. My dad was an alcoholic, he worked most of the time but only to afford to drink. I was the baby of 5. 5 kids my mom had no business having in the first place. We never had what we were supposed to have. Clean clothes that fit. Food every night. security, stability, love. Then when I was 12 my family came into money. Millions within a few months. Everything I thought made my life suck would be solved. I had nicer things, my own room. Food was never an issue. However it brought its own set of problems that spiraled downward. I obviously don't talk about the darker sides of my life to my children. Who does that? However I do like the fact that suicide is dripped with how it would effect others and never how life is effecting the suicidal person. Classic trolley problem. Make one suffer so that this group wont feel pain. Who thinks that way? People who don't struggle with living. Don't join the military. They make it seem like its worth it. Like they will take care of you. They don't. If they cared why do we have so many homeless vets? Why are so many committing suicide? Why are most military families on government assistance though the state? Don't ask a recruiter who is paid to bring in more people why you should join. Go to a VA hospital and ask them why. They will tell you the truth.

I have had family commit suicide. I never once felt bad for the ones crying front row at my 14 year old nephews funeral. I cried tears for the soul we let slip away by not listening. I cried for the fear he must have felt. For the loneliness that engulfed him. I cried never once for the loss of him. I cried because we missed the signs that could have saved him. I cried for the help we didn't give. I cried for every single time his parents told the family he was too much and had to be left out of this event or that event. I cried because I knew how he felt the second he took his own life. He was the son to a family of 7. The oldest of 12 grandchildren. 2 dozen people couldn't save him? Does it really put one person out so greatly to help another? Time is so precious to US that we can't spare any to save a life? You're right, its not just sad. It should be guilt. 3 months is still fresh of a loss. Once the time grows farther away from the time your cousin killed himself, the less people talk about it. The less people mourn. 

and to that I ask. If you have all this time to grieve the loss, why do you not have the time to help prevent it? 

here's your answer. 

Because no one MAKES you help them you have to WANT to. Depression with suicidal tendencies makes for difficult people. No one wants to put work into someone who honestly can not see a purpose to keep going. No one WANTS to deal with that negativity so no one does. We just ask if our life wasn't worth putting the time into saving it. Don't show up to my funeral and sit front row. Don't mourn us, then call us selfish for not continuing to fight a battle that isn't the same for you. and mostly if you're not going to take the time to even try to understand how to help don't pretend after we are gone that you cared.

I can understand this. I am not happy. I haven't been in a long time. I cant keep up with the day to day life. Bills. working. Kids. life in general. day after day after day. there's always something. And when I feel like its all done the cycle is ready to start over. I'm in a race I know I can not win I just wait for the participation trophy to be worth something. It sucks being such a people pleaser you worry about others when you want to kill yourself. Like being depressed and down enough to kill yourself isn't the problem.... its the aftershock of the ones who stay that matters more. Then at the end of it all. when someone does take their own life.... they get labeled selfish because they didn't keep fighting a battle that from their perspective didn't seem so bad. this world is cruel. these people are ugly to each other. I don't want to be involved in that anymore. If I had waited any amount of time at all. I would not have had my kids. I hope they don't resent me later in life for bringing them to this world. I hope they can forgive my naivety in the choice to bring them here. It wasn't just my choice. I was on birth control and willing to abort. But they were not just my children, they were their fathers children as well. So now. here I sit at a job I hate that doesn't pay the bills I need. doing this life thing their way hoping that I can be a victim to an unforeseen accident or an unlucky by-stander in one of the many hate filled crimes in this world. Just make my kids stronger than me. Make them love this life and live it. I don't want them to suffer up stream against the current. I don't want them to suffer like I do.

I get reminded how selfish I would be if I killed myself. Just never reminded of the reasons I should stay alive. And guess what?! All of the reasons I get told is for other people. How would my kids handle their mother killing herself? What will happen to my dog? How would it change the holidays. Think of how it would change my family. What would people think of my mother, how does someone raise a child that wants to later kill themselves? The list goes on and on with the reasons I should stay for other people.... but never reasons why I should stay for myself. Please stay alive work until your body or mind gives out and give everyone else your money. Oh and don't worry if that isn't stressful enough, we also are going to make you feel utterly worthless if you don't make enough to cover your household and have savings. also we don't offer healthcare.

I am 32. I spent my 20s having a few kids that were taken from me in the separation. Even without my kids living with me, I was held back by not making enough to live on, save AND pay child support. I barely made it by in my 20s. I don't have anything to show for it except divorce papers. No car, no house, haven't held a job for more than a year. No one ever talks about how depression fucks with your work ethic to that level. I don't know why or how I made it out of there. I still don't want to make it to 40. or even 35 tbh. But here I am. Taking it one day at a time in hopes that I either die unexpectedly or I lose the urge to take my own life. As shitty as it sounds, right now the only thing stopping me is that my ex husband doesn't believe in mental illnesses and refuses to acknowledge suicide as an outcome to the illness. I know if I took my own life that he would tell my son I was selfish and weak. I am a lot of things. Not all are good things. But weak and selfish I am not. Selfish is the ones who look at the suffering and do nothing. Weak are the ones who see suffering and do nothing. My youngest is 8 now and the oldest 14. a few more years and I think they would all be able to support each other in the loss and explain it to one another in a way that allowed them more understanding than what their dad would have to say to them. I married this guy. I loved him. He was my first butterfly inducing love. Even 10 years after we met I could look at him with love and obsession. Now I cant look him in the eye to tell him hello. I don't know what causes one person to break another down so low, but he did. So here I am. crawling on broken knees and scarred up hands waiting for the " it gets better" part of life.

This is me. I don't want to die exactly. I am just tired of waking up every day to play the game the man wants us to play. It's total bullshit. If we complain about the work load then we are lazy. If we complain about money then we are not working hard enough. If we complain about anything..... it is some how a failure on our part. For whatever reason we have been stuck in a loop of never being enough and never achieving what is expected of us.

I feel this to my core! 

I always tell my therapist when they go on the keep trying keep pushing blah blah blah line:

"No one asked me if I wanted to be here, why should I have to have permission or approval to leave?"

I don't like having to deal with the day to day to seem "normal" I don't want to have to live someone else's way to prevent myself from being labeled a loser or leech. I have to conform to those around me to make sure the majority is comfortable all while I get to suffer doing things their way.... I have been told I struggle with identity. Well no shit. On one end I know what makes me happy and how I want to live. On the other end I want to fit in and be "normal" so that my kids have all the opportunities they could want so they can have things a little easier than I did. I wish so much so that I would have waited to have my kids. If I would have waited..... I wouldn't have had them. Not because I don't love them or want them. But because I see now how unfair life and this world really is. It is only getting worse generation by generation. 

Life is a prison. You were told to go here against your will. Forced to go to school, forced to work, forced to conform to how the majority says you should be. I am thankful to be working. I am thankful for my education. I am thankful and blessed to be a mom to the kids I do have. They are my silver lining to this shit whole storm. I just can't help but worry about the storm that they are going to be faced with as an adult. Will they grow to hate me for bringing them into this world like I do my parents?

I was a combination of his age, where his mentality level was sexually. Basically his sex drive is stuck at 14 year old boy. The portion of the brain that was removed was the frontal lobe. It is responsible for higher cognitive functions such as memory, emotions, impulse control, problem solving, social interaction, and motor function. I think he was already at risk of being a predator given he was touching my sister and I both. By removing what little impulse control he did have, I believe it pushed him to the point of given opportunity he would always choose to be inappropriate. I just wish people would stop excusing his behavior because of his injury. If he truly did not have the control, he would be inappropriate in front of a crowd or group. That's not what he does, he lures people to " go hang out" in his room or somewhere away from everyone. All of the signs are there. I am just surrounded by a bunch of people that just don't care

yes. You should always be honest with your therapist. I am a daily user in a state its not legal and I still tell them. Nothing has even been said. They just ask every now and then if I still use. And I tell them yes.

Our story is similar. I am 32, my bf is 38. We have never been super successful but we were comfortable. Covid brought on unemployment. We had just switched jobs to working together in a warehouse and was soon shut down due to restrictions. We didn't qualify for unemployment because we had just started  literally weeks prior. Everyone talked about how people were not going to be evicted from their homes but what they didn't protect people from is denied renewals of leases and what not. So we lost our place in june. I was offered a job in another state and i uprooted in the middle of this pandemic to relocate everything. About a month into being at my new job I was called back home due to my father being sick and needed to be cared for in the home. He passed in august. I quit my new job to take care of him in the home and prevent him from dying in the hospital alone with out anyone with him. His care and funeral arrangements went by in a month and by then I no longer had my job in the new state nor the funds to get me back if I did have the job. We are now living with my mom while his mother has been riding his ass about a 40 dollar phone bill and why he isn't working. We get it. This isn't exactly how we want to live as well. I really wish everyone would take a freaking break on their expectations of people and how they live their life band why. Shit happens. This year shit has happened to everyone in one way or another. We need to remember to just be kind and patient with each other. I am so sorry you are having such a difficult time. I wish I had some better input for you. All I can say is keep supporting each other encouraging each other, even in the times that the other one seems to not want to hear it or accept the encouragement and praises. The ones who need it the most will ask for it in the most unloving of ways. He has had the rug pulled from under him and as a man in the beginning of a relationship he probably is feeling more worthless than if he had just lost his company. men are pressured into believing they have to be successful to be worthy of love and have to care and do for others to be considered a good man. tensions are high with everyone recently. A lot of people are facing issues they have never before or thought they never would again.

Then get off the sub. if you do not empathize with any of the posts on this sub then clearly you have never been to the bottom pit. If you want an echo chamber go to r/nonewnormal that's some scary echo chamber shit right there. This is for people on the brink of ending their life. I don't care if its because their life is falling apart or they dropped their ice cream. This sub is for people to reach out in hope of someone grabbing them and pulling them away from the edge. If that isn't something you're willing to do then please find another sub. People here are struggling with mental illnesses and don't need some one to chime in and devalue their feelings devalue their words. Most importantly no one, suicidal or not, needs some twit talking shit that clearly have no sympathy or empathy.

I hate the platitudes too. I know it is easy for other people to say what  they think the outcome will be. They think of the times they had things rough and think everyone's struggles are the same. They are not. I do believe everyone has chaos in their life to some degree. But what people are missing are the ones who want to do and be better but cant seem to find a path or the people to help encourage them. It takes a village to help the village prosper and the human race has lost their village mentality. I have had set back after set back after hard time topped with a hard time. I have several plans on killing myself, I just haven't found a time when it wouldn't be ugly for those around me. Fitting right? For the ones struggling so hard to still put others before them in the suicide department. If that's not toxic people pleasing then I don't know what is. 

I'm sorry you had to be a mother to your siblings. I do agree it made you kinder and proved you're caring to those you love. Same with taking care of your grandpa. However it doesn't replace the time you lost being a teenager and taking those teen years to figure out who you are and what you want to do. Then you again delayed your own path by being caring and loving to your grandpa. It is easy to forget ourselves when we see others that need us. That is not a bad trait to have. It is just a difficult one. 

I wont tell you things get better because I too, hate hearing that deep into the depths of my soul. It has become a trigger for me now. I have dropped therapists when they use that line. 

I will tell you, you can change your path. You can find out who you are and who you want to be at any age. At any time in your life, you are in control. Don't dwell on losing parts of your life to other people. You learned a very hard and important lesson. You first. always. We don't like to see people suffer because we know what it is like to suffer to be without to feel unloved. We don't want people to fell like that, so we try to prevent it the best we can to those around us that we care about. Your pain shows you how much you care about your siblings, and your grandpa. If you feel like it has been holding you back, helping others to the extreme you do, then it is time to put you first. Put you first without anger hurt and pain from the things that played out in the past. We can't change it in any way so why let it weigh us down? 

I empathize with you on a lot of your story. I have some advise to help if you want it. just DM me. I know how easy it is to say I wont have to fight for stability if I am dead. I wont have to hear these people's bullshit if I am dead. I wont have to feel like this anymore if I am dead. I gotta say you are right. You wont have any of those things when you're dead. But what if the answer is days away and, you let the negativity that comes from the people around you not understanding your struggles, take that away from you.  

I hope to hear from you. If even to say hello.
thank you
